Eg 1 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: /abc/def/username) The user will land at /abcd/def/username, and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2. Eg 2 - (bucket_name: bucket, bucket_prefix: path1/path2, directory: '') The user will land at '/', and the view there will match that of /bucket/path1/path2.
